items: Page navigation now shows a loading progress bar.
Icons are sharper and more consistent across navigation, event sharing, and relay actions.
Page titles now have consistent sizing and styling across blogs, events, groups, and pages.
Editing controls stay visible in a sticky bottom action panel, without automatically scrolling the page.
Forms and light-mode colors have refined styling, including clearer checkbox borders.
Long links and markdown content wrap more naturally, while page layouts adapt better on medium-sized screens.
